_comment: Committed snapshot. Used when no sheet is configured (local dev) or when the Sheets fetch fails, so the site never ships empty. Refresh it with `npm run data -- --save-fallback` once your sheet is live. Keys are the lowercased sheet headers.

projects.title: Real-Time Sub-Object Detector
projects.tagline: On-device Android detection that finds the objects inside an object, at frame rate.
projects.description: An Android application that performs real-time sub-object detection through image classification — identifying not just what is in frame, but the distinct components within a detected object. The detection pipeline was deliberately built as an isolated, reusable module rather than app-specific code, so it can be lifted into a larger system without a rewrite.
projects.tech: Kotlin, Android, Machine Learning, Image Classification
projects.problem: A conventional classifier labels a whole scene. Identifying the parts inside an already-detected object needs a second inference pass — which still has to keep up with the camera preview on mid-range phone hardware.
projects.role: Sole developer — architecture, model integration, Android application
projects.impact: Runs entirely on-device at interactive frame rates, with the detection layer packaged for reuse instead of being welded to one screen.

projects.title: Twitter Clone
projects.tagline: Full-stack social app — post, follow, and watch it land without a refresh.
projects.description: A full-stack Twitter-like application where users post tweets, follow each other, and interact in real time. React drives a responsive frontend, Firebase Authentication handles secure sign-in, and Firestore keeps every client in sync live. Releases go out through a CI/CD pipeline, so builds and deployments are automated rather than remembered.
projects.problem: A social feed is only convincing if it updates itself. Doing that without a backend of my own meant leaning on Firestore's realtime listeners and designing the data model around read patterns rather than tidy normalisation.
projects.role: Sole developer — frontend, authentication, data model, deploy pipeline
projects.impact: Feed and follow state update live across clients with no manual refresh; automated deploys removed the manual release step entirely.

projects.title: Java Arcade — Tic Tac Toe & Snake
projects.tagline: Two classics built from primitives, to actually learn the machinery.
projects.description: Tic Tac Toe and Snake, written in Java during advanced programming coursework. Game loop, state transitions, collision handling and input were all built from language primitives rather than pulled from a game framework — the objective was understanding how the pieces fit, not shipping quickly.
